items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 145:1
items.html:
(to the question) Breasts
The dadim [breasts] are called on account of the level of the Hassadim that is drawn from the breasts. And the shadayim are called on account of the illumination of AB that begins to be revealed from there, in the secret of AB, 216, and 26, which in Gematria is Shaddai. As above, in answer 143. (Part 1, Page 240, Item 288).
